import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem uniformContinuousOn_three_stage_local_agreement
  {α β γ δ : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] [UniformSpace γ] [UniformSpace δ]
  {f : α → β} {g : β → γ} {h : γ → δ}
  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hg : UniformContinuous g) (hh : UniformContinuous h)
  (s : Set α) (m : α → β) (hm : ∀ x, x ∈ s → m x = f x) :
  UniformContinuousOn (fun x => h (g (m x))) s := by
  have h1 : UniformContinuous (fun x => h (g (f x))) := hh.comp (hg.comp hf)
  have h2 : UniformContinuousOn (fun x => h (g (f x))) s := h1.uniformContinuousOn
  exact h2.congr (fun x hx => by rw [hm x hx])

theorem uniformContinuousOn_three_stage_local_agreement

  (s : Set α) (m : α → β) (hm : ∀ x, x ∈ s → m x = f x) :
  UniformContinuousOn (fun x => h (g (m x))) s := by
  have h_comp : UniformContinuous (fun x => h (g (f x))) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp] using hh.comp (hg.comp hf)
  have h_on : UniformContinuousOn (fun x => h (g (f x))) s := by
    first
    | exact h_comp.uniformContinuousOn s
    | exact UniformContinuous.uniformContinuousOn h_comp s
    | exact h_comp.uniformContinuousOn
    | aesop
  have h_eq : ∀ x ∈ s, h (g (f x)) = h (g (m x)) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← hm x hx]

    intro x hx
    simp only [h_eq x hx]
  first
  | exact UniformContinuousOn.congr h_on h_eq'
  | exact h_on.congr h_eq'
  | aesop
